subject: Lighthouse POC - request for short trial buffer due to integration delay
messages:
From: Darya Novak <darya@lighthouse.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Park <evan.park@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial buffer for Lighthouse POC

Hi Karthik —

Quick note from our engineering lead: we hit a snag with the connector that prevents us from running a representative load against Redwood's sandbox this week. The fix is small (missing env var + an adapter mapping) but the team is tied up with a release patch and can't finish until Friday.

We're two weeks into the POC and still confident in the integration, but we need a ~5 business day buffer on the trial/credits so we can validate end-to-end once the fix lands. If possible, we'd also like to keep the sandbox instance alive (don't terminate the ephemeral dataset) so we don't lose progress.

Attached: lighthouse-integration-log.txt (excerpt) and our updated POC plan (poc-plan-v2.pdf).

Appreciate anything you can do — this POC is on a tight timeline for our Q3 roadmap.

Thanks,
Darya Novak
Head of Product
Lighthouse Labs

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Darya Novak <darya@lighthouse.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial buffer for Lighthouse POC

Thanks for the heads-up, Darya — sorry to hear about the timing. I can absolutely start the approval process for a short buffer. Two quick clarifying questions before I loop ops/finance:

- How many additional tokens or dollars would you expect to need for the 5 business day window? (estimate is fine)
- Any compliance/security artifacts you expect us to keep live (log retention, exported audit logs)?

I'll flag this to Marissa and Marcus for a quick sign-off. If you can send a one-line estimate for credits, that will speed things up.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: short trial buffer for Lighthouse POC

Karthik — forwarding Darya's ask. Given Lighthouse is in an active evaluation (deal DL-2025-089) and they've shown steady usage, I'm ok with a limited buffer. Marcus — can we approve a 5-business-day sandbox hold + $2,500 credit as a one-time gesture? Confirming we keep the ephemeral dataset for the week and enable extended log retention for 14 days.

If finance needs a reason code: "integration delay — POC continuity".

Marissa
Senior Sales Manager

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: short trial buffer for Lighthouse POC

Marissa / Karthik —

Approved: 5 business days buffer + $2,500 credit applied to the Lighthouse POC. Ops: keep the sandbox active and retain logs for an additional 14 days. Finance: apply credit code RDW-POC-2025-089 when billing window is evaluated.

Two operational notes:
- We should notify Support to prioritize any further blocker tickets from their team while the buffer is active.
- If they request another extension, we need an engineering remediation plan with ETA before approving.

I'll send the official approval note to Karthik to pass to Darya.

Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Darya Novak <darya@lighthouse.ai>, Evan Park <evan.park@lighthouse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 May 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial buffer for Lighthouse POC

Hi Darya / Evan — good news: we've approved a 5 business day buffer and attached $2,500 in one-time credits for the POC (deal DL-2025-089). The sandbox will remain active through Friday, 23 May 2025 and logs will be retained for 14 days. Support will prioritize your escalation if anything else pops up.

Next steps for Lighthouse:
- Evan: confirm you received the buffer and that the POC instance stays accessible after your patch lands Friday.
- Darya: if the team thinks they'll need more than a single extension, please send a short remediation plan + ETA and we'll review.

Attachments: poc-plan-v2.pdf (copy of updated POC timeline).

Thanks — looking forward to getting you back to full load testing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
